outcome: quality of basic emergency obstetric and newborn care (BEmONC) services from the mothers' perspective
cohort: Mothers receiving at least one basic emergency obstetric and newborn care (BEmONC) service in selected public health centers in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: The overall quality of BEmONC services from the mothers' perspective was 56.9%, and it was predicted by age, monthly income, presence of a companion, and payment for services.
